# Historical resolution dossier template

Use this template for consequential or non-trivial Class D identity/resolution claims.

The dossier is a review artifact. It does not become historical evidence merely because it is complete.

Prefer references to canonical SourceRecords and assertions over duplicating source data.

## Source dependency / corroboration audit

Identify which pieces of apparent evidence share one upstream historical source chain.

Example:

`scholarly database row → archival signatura → modern catalogue representation`

Do not count one source chain as multiple independent witnesses.
